section.title: Documents and bulk reads
section.subtitle: Read PDF / Word / CSV, read several file ranges at once, dry-run edits; the backend is dsh-ops, a Rust worker
field.status.label: Current status
field.status.help: Registers thirteen tools: seven read-only (documents, spreadsheets, bulk read, diff, file check, hex view) and six write tools (whole-file write, multi-edit, copy, move, remove, whole-directory replace). Every write goes through approval.
field.workerResolved.label: Worker path
field.workerPath.label: Worker path (leave empty to auto-detect)
field.workerPath.help: The search order is ~/.dsc/plugins/node_modules/dsh-ops, then ~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/dsh-ops; the DSC_OPS_WORKER environment variable is also read. Installing dsh-ops once is enough for it to be found.
field.timeoutMs.label: Time limit per call (ms)
field.timeoutMs.help: Reading one big document can take a few seconds; past this limit the call gives up and reports an error instead of stalling the whole turn.
field.toolsInfo.label: What these tools do
field.missing.label: No dsh-ops installed?
field.missing.text: Run npm install dsh-ops in ~/.dsc/plugins and reopen this plugin; or put the absolute path of dsh-ops-worker in the field above.
save.workerPathSaved: Path saved, but no worker was found: {reason}. The thirteen tools stay as they are; nothing was removed.
save.workerPathUpdated: Path updated and all thirteen tools are registered (from {source}).
save.badTimeout: The time limit must be a number.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
